name: Hacker News
description: Browse Hacker News stories and comments.
author: WebMCP Anywhere

tools.name: hn_top_stories
tools.title: List stories
tools.description: List the stories on the current Hacker News page (front page, /newest, /ask, etc.) in on-page order. Returns parallel arrays `titles`, `urls` (external article links), `sites` (source domains) and `scores` (e.g. "123 points"; job postings have no score so `scores` may be shorter). Index 1 = first story; use it with hn_open_story / hn_open_comments. Read-only.

limit.description: Maximum number of stories to return (1-30 per page).

tools.name: hn_open_story
tools.title: Open story link
tools.description: Open the N-th story's article link (1 = first on the page) in the current tab. The page navigates to the external article. Returns the clicked title in `did`.

index.description: 1-based position of the story on the page.

tools.name: hn_open_comments
tools.title: Open comments
tools.description: Open the Hacker News comment thread for the N-th story (1 = first on the page). The page navigates to the item page. Returns `title` and the comments `url`. Note: job postings have no comments link, so on pages with jobs the index may be offset by one.

index.description: 1-based position of the story on the page.

tools.name: hn_read_comments
tools.title: Read comments
tools.description: On a Hacker News item page, read the story `title`, `url`, and the first N comments as `comments` (array of strings, in thread order; nested replies are included in order). Read-only.

limit.description: Maximum number of comments to return (1-50).

tools.name: hn_next_page
tools.title: Next page
tools.description: Go to the next page of stories by clicking the "More" link at the bottom of the list. The page reloads. Returns the run log in `did`.

tools.name: hn_go
tools.title: Switch listing
tools.description: Navigate to a Hacker News listing: front (top stories), newest, ask, show, jobs, or best. The page reloads. Returns the URL that was opened.

listing.description: Which listing to open ("news" is the front page).
